ui.rail_safe: Your TV stays safe: nothing is changed until you confirm, and Restore puts it back.
ui.close_prompt: Setup is still running. Closing now may leave your TV half set up. Close anyway?
ui.welcome_lead: Install the NLRC home screen, or put your TV back the way it was.
ui.install_text: Put the NLRC home screen on your TV.
ui.restore_text: Remove NLRC and bring your TV’s own home screen back.
ui.prepare_lead: Three quick things on the TV, once.
ui.prepare_1: On the TV open **Settings → System → About** and click **Build** 7 times.
ui.prepare_2: Go to **Settings → System → Developer options** and turn on **USB debugging** and **Network debugging** if you see it.
ui.prepare_3: Make sure this computer and the TV are on the same Wi-Fi.
ui.xiaomi_note: On Xiaomi TVs the menu may be called Device Preferences → About.
ui.warned_summary: Windows/Mac warned me when I opened this app
ui.warned_mac: **Mac:** if it says the app can't be opened, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** (on older macOS: right-click the app and choose **Open**).
ui.found_title: Found these TVs on your Wi-Fi
ui.none_found: No TVs found. Type the IP address below.
ui.ip_hint: TV IP: Settings → Network & Internet → your Wi-Fi
ui.connecting: Look at your TV and choose **Always allow from this computer**.
ui.connecting_wait: This can take up to a minute.
ui.step_restore_launchers: Turning your original home screen back on
ui.done_restore_text: Your original home screen is back.
ui.generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ui.unsupported_android: This TV runs {android} without Google TV. It isn't supported yet, so nothing was changed.
